title: Podcast Ingest
description: Entry point of the episode-analysis pipeline. Takes a chat question whose context names a project in the account file store ('project: projects/<episode>'), validates and probes the source recording (analysis/media.json), forwards the episode reference on the text lane, streams the audio to audio_transcribe as exact fixed-length pieces (audio lane, one stream per piece so every sentence timestamp can be placed on the episode timeline) and, when wired, streams the full recording on the video lane for frame-based stock nodes.

podcast_ingest.piece_seconds.title: Audio piece length sent to the transcriber (s, max 60)
